About · DJ Aadhi
The sound Coimbatore moves to — every night, every floor.

DJ Aadhi is a DJ and producer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. He plays club nights, weddings and receptions, college fests and festival stages — reading the room, keeping the floor full and building every set around the crowd in front of him.
